title: Question for Ink Master
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was about to inquire about the whereabouts of the fifth page, the first page of the Tianji Record suddenly trembled violently, and Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul actually showed fear for the first time—something was following their conversation.

text.content:
The night was as dark as ink, and the mountain wind wailed. Chen Ji sat alone on the Cliff of Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, his clothes flapping loudly in the wind, yet he remained motionless. Cang Yutian's parting words still echoed in his mind—the Fourth Path.

He had walked two of the three paths: those who followed heaven's fate became chess pieces, those who defied heaven were crushed to dust. So where does the fourth path, beyond the third, lead?

He slowly closed his eyes, his consciousness sinking deep into the Mental Sea. There floated a page of yellowed fragment, the first page of the Tianji Record glowing with a faint light. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul resided upon it, like a flickering solitary lamp.

dialogue.content: Mr. Mo, your disciple has a question to ask.

text.content:
On the first page of the Tianji Record, Mo Xiansheng's phantom slowly materialized. He sat cross-legged, his face aged and profound, yet his turbid eyes seemed capable of piercing through ancient and modern times.

"This old man has waited three years for you to ask this question." Mo Xiansheng's voice was aged and calm, "You wish to ask—the true origin of the Tianji Record, and why it chose you?"

Chen Ji's heart trembled. He indeed wanted to ask, but had never mentioned it to anyone. Mr. Mo had seen through it with a single word.

dialogue.content: "Not only that." Mo Xiansheng raised his eyes toward a certain point in the void, "What you truly wish to ask is—whether the fate you write is also on someone else's chessboard?"

text.content:
Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. This was precisely the fear that haunted him most. From the moment he obtained the Tianji Record, he had隐隐察觉—could he see the future, could others also see him seeing?

Every time he used the Tianji Record, that feeling of being watched never disappeared. He had simply never dared to think deeply, never dared to ask.

Mo Xiansheng sighed: "You've finally dared to ask. This is good. Only by asking the right questions can one find answers."

choice.prompt: Chen Ji took a deep breath, preparing to consult Mr. Mo on the nature of his fate-writing ability—

choices.description: Where did the Tianji Record come from? Why did it appear in Cang Yutian's hands, and why was it passed to me?
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key information: the truth about the Tianji Record's origin
choices.risk_hint: Mr. Mo might not answer directly

text.content: Chen Ji said in a deep voice: "Where did the Tianji Record come from? How did Senior Cang Yutian obtain it? Your disciple needs an answer."

choices.description: Am I also being manipulated by higher beings? Is the Tianji Record an opportunity or a trap?
choices.risk_hint: The truth may be more cruel than imagined

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze sharpened: "I write fate, yet cannot see my own fate. Mr. Mo, am I also merely a chess piece on someone else's board?"

choices.description: Does the Fourth Path mentioned by Cang Yutian exist? Could that be the method to transcend the chess game?
choices.visible_cost: Expose that I already know the secret
choices.visible_reward: Obtain guidance on the possibility of transcending the chess game
choices.risk_hint: Mr. Mo might not know the answer

text.content: Chen Ji blurted out: "Senior Cang Yutian mentioned the Fourth Path—the path that is neither following heaven nor defying heaven. Mr. Mo, does that path exist?"

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment, his phantom trembling slightly. Only after a long while did he speak, his voice carrying a weight Chen Ji had never heard before: "Do you know—the Tianji Record was not originally used to foresee the future, but to—oppose."

text.content:
"Oppose?" Chen Ji's brow furrowed tightly.

Mo Xiansheng raised his eyes to the night sky, as if he could pierce through layers of clouds to see something far above: "The original master of the Tianji Record was not human. Cang Yutian brought it out from an ancient ruin, and by then it already had a master—or rather, its own will."

"Cang Yutian tamed it with his life's effort, transforming it from a simple prophecy tool into a treasure capable of writing fate. But his original intention for transforming it was never to dominate the world."

dialogue.content: "The original master—Cang Yutian's master, wanted to oppose... heaven itself?" Chen Ji voiced the uncertain guess in his heart, his voice trembling slightly.

text.content:
Mo Xiansheng slowly shook his head: "Not heaven. Heaven is merely... a projection of the will of higher beings. What you oppose is not some illusory concept, but a being with consciousness, with purpose, that is currently watching you and me."

Chen Ji felt a chilling sensation to his bones. The Eye of Heavenly Way—he had seen this name in some ancient texts, thinking it merely the foolish fancy of primitive people. Now considering it, perhaps those "foolish" legends were the true reality.

"So the Tianji Record is essentially a—"

choice.prompt: Chen Ji was deeply understanding the nature of the Tianji Record—

choices.description: The Tianji Record is a weapon against higher beings, which explains why using it comes at a cost—every Heavenly Fate value is a contest for control with that being
choices.visible_cost: The heaviness brought by understanding this truth
choices.visible_reward: Fundamentally understood the value and danger of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: Realized what he is truly up against

text.content: Chen Ji murmured: "So the Tianji Record is not a prophecy tool, but a weapon—a weapon to contest causal control with the being watching us."

choices.description: The Tianji Record is a prison set by higher beings, making prophets think they are writing fate when they are actually only moving within the limits it permits
choices.visible_cost: May shake trust in the Tianji Record
choices.visible_reward: Obtain clues to breaking out of the prison

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze suddenly turned sharp: "Or in other words—it is itself a prison? Making us think we are writing fate when we are merely moving on the board that existence has drawn?"

dialogue.content:
"Both and neither." Mo Xiansheng's phantom sighed faintly, "The Tianji Record's本体 is merely a blank sheet of paper. It can become a weapon or a prison—the key lies with the one who wields it.

Cang Yutian made it a weapon. And you... need to make it a existence that transcends the chess game itself.

text.content:
Chen Ji's brow furrowed tightly: "Transcend the chess game? But if even the Eye of Heavenly Way is on the board, how can I transcend?"

Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment, as if weighing how much to say. Finally, he slowly spoke: "You asked the right question. The essence of fate-writing is not altering results—the results were already destined. The true essence is rewriting causality."

"Causality?"

"People of this world think fate is a straight line from cause to effect, not knowing that causality itself can be rewritten. The Tianji Record's true power does not lie in letting you see the future, but in—letting you rewrite all possibilities leading to that future."

choice.prompt: Chen Ji was digesting this shocking information—

choices.description: Request Mr. Mo to teach the specific method of rewriting causality, even if it means paying a greater price
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key guidance on rewriting causality
choices.risk_hint: Mr. Mo's answer may require a price

text.content: Chen Ji bowed respectfully: "Please, Mr. Mo, give your disciple guidance—what should I do?"

choices.description: Press for more truth about the Eye of Heavenly Way and higher beings—know yourself and your enemy to win a hundred battles
choices.visible_cost: May touch upon secrets Mr. Mo is reluctant to mention
choices.visible_reward: Learn more about the enemy's information
choices.risk_hint: Mr. Mo may fall silent because of this

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze burned intensely: "That existence watching us—the Eye of Heavenly Way, what exactly is it? What is its purpose?"

dialogue.content:
Mo Xiansheng's phantom suddenly trembled violently, as if touching upon some taboo. His voice became ethereal: "You ask too much. Some answers... are not yet for you to know."

As Chen Ji was about to press further, Mo Xiansheng suddenly changed the subject: "But there is one thing this old man can tell you. The Tianji Record has five pages; currently you only possess three fragments."

text.content:
"Five pages?" Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. He had always believed the Tianji Record consisted of only three fragments—the first page sealed with Mr. Mo's soul, the second page containing cultivation methods, the third page the prophecy ability. As for the other two pages—he had never seen them.

Mo Xiansheng nodded, his voice growing increasingly low: "The first page is the foundation, sealed with this old man's remnant soul. The second page is the cultivation method, recording how to use the power of Heavenly Secrets. The third page is prophecy, allowing you to see three hours into the future."

"Then the fourth and fifth pages..."

"The fourth page," Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly became extremely heavy, "is Cang Yutian's final legacy. It records the ultimate method to oppose the Eye of Heavenly Way—but that page is hidden in a place you would never imagine."

Chen Ji's heartbeat骤然加速. Cang Yutian's ultimate method—couldn't that be the "Fourth Path" he had been seeking?

However, Mo Xiansheng's next words made him feel as if he had fallen into an icy abyss: "As for the fifth page... even this old man only knows it exists but has never seen it. Before Cang Yutian's death, he only left a riddle—'It lies in your origin, and in your destination.'"

Chen Ji froze. Origin? Destination? His origin was Chen Family Village, that small village already destroyed by the Holy Sect. And what was his destination?

At this moment, the first page of the Tianji Record suddenly trembled violently, and Mo Xiansheng's phantom abruptly looked up, his face showing fear for the first time.

"Someone is coming." Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly became urgent, "following our conversation—Chen Ji, the connection between us has been discovered!"

Chen Ji opened his eyes sharply. Mo Xiansheng's voice in his Mental Sea cut off abruptly, and the light on the first page of the Tianji Record quickly dimmed, as if it had never been lit.

The night wind still wailed, and the Cliff remained desolate. But Chen Ji knew something was approaching. That feeling of being watched was more intense than ever before.

He slowly stood up, his gaze fixed on the distant horizon. Origin... destination... the fifth page...

All clues pointed in the same direction—Chen Family Village, that erased homeland destroyed by the Holy Sect.
